Ranks are a way of showing what tier are you on the DonutSMP. Most ranks can be bought using real life money, and some may be handed out by the staff team. There are only 4 known player ranks on the DonutSMP.

== List of Ranks ==

=== Donut+ ===
[[File:Donut+ on DonutSMP store.png|thumb|Donut+ on the official DonutSMP store]]
The Donut+ rank can be obtained by purchasing it on the [https://store.donutsmp.net/store official DonutSMP store.] This rank gives you 6 more homes than the default (3 homes by default, Donut+ gives you 9 homes max), 45 auction slots, and 45 order slots. Donut+ costs $5.01 USD a month. 

=== Donut++ ===
[[File:Donut++ on the DonutSMP store.png|thumb|Donut++ on the official DonutSMP store]]
Donut++, like Donut+ can be also bought on the official DonutSMP store. This rank gives you max 27 homes, 90 auction slots, and 90 order slots. Donut++ costs $10.03 USD a month.

=== Donut+++ ===
This is the third and last rank purchasable through the official DonutSMP store. This rank gives you 90 homes, 90 auction slots, and 90 order slots. Donut++ is the most expensive, costing $15.05 USD a month.

=== Media ===
Media rank requires one of the following requirements completed:

* 25 average live concurrent viewers on a Twitch or YouTube longform live stream (with no big raids)
* 100 average live concurrent viewers on a TikTok or YouTube Short live stream[[File:Donut+++ on the DonutSMP store.png|thumb|Donut+++ on the official DonutSMP store]]5k views on a YouTube Video

* 50k views on a TikTok Video

* 50k views on a YouTube Short
* 50k views on an Instagram Reel

'''Other Requirements:'''

* The content must be about DonutSMP
* The content must have the server IP on screen for the whole video
* You have to show analytics of the video to prove it's real
* If you have one of the requirements, you can create a ticket for the rank at [https://support.donutsmp.net/ this link.]

The Media rank lasts 90 days and has the same perks as Donut+++.
